title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
text: We introduce LLaMA, a collection of foundation language models ranging from 7B to 65B parameters. We train our models on trillions of tokens using publicly available datasets exclusively, making it possible to achieve state-of-the-art performance without relying on proprietary data.
text_summary: LLaMA: open-source foundation LLMs trained on public data achieve state-of-the-art results.
